It has been speculated that, as the blowholes evolved and migrated to the top of the head, the neural pathways serving sense of smell may have been nearly all sacrificed.

Visual Symbols and the Blind From a number of recent studies, it has become clear that blind people can appreciate the use of outlines and perspectives to describe the arrangement of objects and other surfaces in space.

the [抽象名词: estimate/misconception/inform.gloss: ……这一估计/误解/说法（that 从句作同位语，说明前面的抽象名词内容）
the [抽象名词: estimate/misconception/inform.notes: 清单中「同位语插入」指 NP 同位语；这是 that 从句型同位语，属新类型。抽象名词 + that + 陈述句，that 是连词不是关系代词，从句内主谓齐全。学习者极易把 that 当关系代词去找先行词缺位，是最经典的误读点。

examples.s: For example, one graphic illustration to which children might readily relate is the estimate that rainforests are being destroyed at a rate equivalent to one thousand football fields every forty minutes – about the duration of a normal classroom period.

While two fifths of the students provided the information that the rainforests provide oxygen, in some cases this response also embraced the misconception that rainforest destruction would reduce atmospheric oxygen, making the atmosphere incompatible with human life on Earth.

The [第N] question / Responses to questio.gloss: 第 N 个问题涉及/考察……（研究报告问卷句式）
The [第N] question / Responses to questio.notes: concerned 是过去式谓语动词（涉及），不是形容词「有关的」。固定语序：问题编号 + concerned + 话题 NP。本篇研究报道中三次复现（I00027/I00030/I00035），学习者常误读为「被关心的」从而解错句意。

examples.s: The second question concerned the geographical location of rainforests.
Responses to question three concerned the importance of rainforests.
The fourth question concerned the causes of the destruction of rainforests.

[S] seem/appear to [V / have V-ed].notes: 与已报的 tend to[V]、be likely to 同一家族的认知缓和框架，但 seem/appear 版未在清单。不定式可带完成体（appear to have deteriorated）。注意 I03496 中出现在 which 引导的关系从句内。

examples.s: Baleen species, on the other hand, appear to have some related brain structures but it is not known whether these are functional.

The South American boutu and Chinese beiji, for instance, appear to have very limited vision, and the Indian susus are blind, their eyes reduced to slits that probably allow them to sense only the direction and intensity of light.

Although the senses of taste and smell appear to have deteriorated, and vision in water appears to be uncertain, such weaknesses are more than compensated for by cetaceans’ well-developed acoustic sense.
Atlit-Yam was a village on the coast of the eastern Mediterranean, which seems to have been thriving until around 7,000 BC.

[主句], while [S V].gloss: ……，而与此同时/相比之下……（句尾对比性 while 从句）
[主句], while [S V].notes: 清单中「While让步, 主句」指前置让步；此为后置对比新变体：while 从句挂在主句之后表对照（非时间、非让步）。学习者易把句尾 while 读成「当……时候」，把对比关系误读为时间关系。I03532 与 I03592 均为主句 + 逗号 + while + 对比句。

examples.s: In many cases it's only these containers that remain, while the wooden ships have been buried under silt on the seabed.

Birds and animals can die gruesome deaths through being trapped or caught up in plastic bags or ropes, while the long process required for these plastics to decay means that they remain a threat for many years to come.

of / by + [NP 主语] + [V-ing].gloss: ……的证据是（某物）正在做某事／由（某人）做某事而实现（带主语的动名词复合结构）
of / by + [NP 主语] + [V-ing].notes: 介词后不接纯动名词而接「名词主语 + V-ing」：evidence of sea creatures ingesting...、by children absorbing...。学习者常把 of/by 后的 NP 当介词宾语读完，再被后面的 -ing 悬挂卡住；与「with+O+补语」同属复合结构家族但介词不同、未被清单覆盖。

examples.s: Worse, there is now beginning to be evidenee of sea creatures ingesting smaller globules of disintegrating plastic, which harms them and all the other creatures in their particular food chain.
These ideas may be developed by children absorbing ideas through the popular media.

[N] in which [S V].notes: 清单有「the way(that/in which)」与「动词+介词+wh-从句」，均未覆盖普通名词后 in which 的定语从句。固定语序：先行名词 + in which + 完整主谓。in which 是高误读点（被拆成 in + which 指代混乱）。

examples.s: Environmental education offers an arena in which these sills can be developed, which is essential fore these children as future decision –makers.
Such variation can no doubt be explained with reference to the habitats in which individual species have developed.

more [X] [to/for/of NP] than [to/for/of.gloss: 对/为 A 而言比 B 更……（比较级后介词短语的平行省略）
more [X] [to/for/of NP] than [to/for/of.notes: more ... than 后第二个介词短语省略了重复的中心词：more useful to A than to B、more the subject of A than of B。学习者常在 than 后找不到比较对象而读慢，或误把 than 后成分当新句子。判据2强：平行省略必须整存整取地识别。

examples.s: For example, vision is obviously more useful to species inhabiting clear open waters than to those living in turbid rivers and flooded plains.

Some of the more complicated sounds are clearly communicative, although what role they may play in the social life and ‘culture’ of cetaceans has been more the subject of wild speculation than of solid science.

examples.s: Never before has the planet’s linguistic diversity shrunk at such a pace. ‘At the moment, we are heading for about three or four languages dominating the world,’ says Mark Pagel, an evolutionary biologist at the University of Reading. ‘It’s a mass extinction, and whether we will ever rebound from the loss is difficult to know.’ Isolation breeds linguistic diversity: as a result, the world is peppered with languages spoken by only a few people.
It begins with a crisis of confidence, when a small community finds itself alongside a larger, wealthier society, says Nicholas Ostler, of Britain’s Foundation for Endangered Languages, in Bath.

Playful young animals use around two or three percent of their energy cavorting, and in children that figure can be closer to fifteen percent.‘Even two or three percent is huge,’ says John Byers of Idaho University. ‘You just don’t find animals wasting energy like that,’ he adds.

主句, according to [NP]（+同位语）.notes: 已有框架 "According to[NP], 主句" 的后置新变体：according to 短语挂在主句句尾，NP 后再接同位语（头衔、职务）。学习者易把句尾 according to 读成悬空成分而失焦。

not [A] but [B].gloss: 不是A而是B（先否定再纠正的对比判断）。
not [A] but [B].notes: 纠正性对比：not 与 but 各接平行成分（表语、介词短语等），平行结构可扩展为 not to [A] but to [B]。与已有清单的 "[A], but not[B]"（先肯后否）语序相反，是另一方向。学习者易把 but 误读为普通转折而丢掉"排除A"之义。

examples.s: But Salikoko Mufwene, who chairs the Linguistics department at the University of Chicago, argues that the deadliest weapon is not government policy but economic globalization.

Typically, children do not end up on the streets due to a single cause, but to a combination of factors: a dearth of adequately funded schools, the demand for income at home, family breakdown and violence.

主句, where [S V].notes: 已有框架 "非限定性关系从句[A], who/which[B]" 的 where 新变体：逗号 + where + 完整主谓，先行项多为地点名词（floor/program/writing systems），也可表条件情形。学习者易把 where 误当疑问词或状语从句。

examples.s: But a written form is essential for this, so the mere possibility of revival has led many speakers of endangered languages to develop systems of writing where none existed before.
• There are tremendous advantages to involving parents or guardians in the program, where such relationships exist.
The biggest eruptions are deep on the mid-ocean floor, where new lava is forcing the continents apart and widening the Atlantic by perhaps five centimeters a year.

Participants in this enterprise were supplied with bicycles, which they used to deliver parcels and messages, and which they were required to pay for gradually from their wages.

examples.s: Although small-scale business training and credit programs have become more common throughout the world, relatively little attention has been paid to the need to direct such opportunities to young people.
Even less attention has been paid to children living on the street or in difficult circumstance.

examples.s: The eruption was so fierce that dust thrown into the stratosphere darkened the skies, cancelling the following summer in Europe and North America.
Anthropology is thus a broad discipline — so broad that it is generally broken down into three smaller disciplines: physical anthropology, cultural anthropology and archaeology.
Indeed, the purple colour extracted from a snail was once so costly that in society at the time only the rich could afford it.

in [a/the] [broadest/restricted/narrow].notes: 学术语篇高频的元语言框架：介词 in/at + 限定词 + 范围形容词 + sense（或省略 sense 直接用 at its 最高级）。sense 在此义为'意义'而非'感觉'，学习者常读错；用于宣告术语的宽窄用法。

examples.s: Anthropology, at its broadest, is the study of humanity — our physical characteristic as animals and our unique non-biological characteristics that we call culture.

Anthropologists also use the term ‘culture’ in a more re- stricted sense when they refer to the ‘culture’ of a particular society, meaning the non- biological characteristics unique to that society, which distinguish it from other societies.

In the broadest sense, just as archaeology is an aspect of anthropology, so too is it a part of history — where we mean the whole history of humankind from its beginnings over three million years ago.
commonly drawn distinction is between pre-history, i.e. the period before written records — and history in the narrow sense, meaning the study of the past using written evidence.

Whereas [主句A], [主句B].notes: 书内已有 While 让步主句、句尾对比 while；此为同族新变体：whereas 从句整体前置、纯粹对比（非让步），主句为对比焦点。whereas 对学习者是低频词，常读慢或与 where/while 混淆。

examples.s: Whereas most exercises are designed to build up strength or endurance, plyometrics focuses on increasing power — the rate at which an athlete can expend energy.

Incorporating potassium dichromate and alcohol into the aniline at various stages of the experimental process, he finally produced a deep purple solution.

For instance, they were used to stain previously invisible microbes and bacteria, allowing researchers to identify such bacilli as tuberculosis, cholera, and anthrax.

[介词] [how/what] [S V].gloss: 在……如何/是什么的方面（介词后接 wh-从句）
[介词] [how/what] [S V].notes: 介词（in/about 等）直接带缩略疑问从句作补语：improvement in how fast athletes run / in what would have been particularly pleasing to Perkin。学习者不习惯介词后跟完整 wh-从句，是最典型的读慢点；what 从句内还含虚拟完成体。

examples.s: — Limits to human sporting performance are not yet in sight — Since the early years of the twentieth century, when the International Athletic Federa- tion began keeping records, there has been a steady improvement in how fast athletes run, how high they jump and how far they are able to hurl massive objects, themselves included, through space.
And, in what would have been particularly pleasing to Perkin, their current use is in the search for a vaccine against malaria.

at (about/exactly) the same time that/as.gloss: 就在……的同时（same...that/as 关联结构）
at (about/exactly) the same time that/as.notes: the same + time + that/as + 完整从句：that 在此非关系代词也非指示词，而是 same 的固定搭配连词，学习者普遍读错；time 前可插 about/exactly/just 等修饰。

examples.s: However, at exactly the same time as this new realization of the finite character of health-care resources was sinking in, an awareness of a contrary kind was developing in Western societies: that people have a basic right to health-care as a necessary condition of a proper human life.
Health-care came to be seen as a right at about the same time that the limits of health-care resources became evident.

[Just as [S V],] [so too] [be/V] [S].gloss: 正如 A 一样，B 也……（so too 倒装回指）
[Just as [S V],] [so too] [be/V] [S].notes: just as + 从句前置（或后置依附主句），配 so too is/does + 主语的倒装回指；so too 倒装是高难读点。两种位置变体：Just as A, so too is B；主句, just as B（无 so too）。

examples.s: In the broadest sense, just as archaeology is an aspect of anthropology, so too is it a part of history — where we mean the whole history of humankind from its beginnings over three million years ago.
The archaeologist has to develop a picture of the past, just as the scientist has to develop a coherent view of the natural world.

the question of whether [S V] / whether.notes: 名词 question 后固定接 of + whether 从句（或 whether to do），不可换成 that；整体可作主语（The question of whether ... has haunted ...）或作动词宾语（debate the question of whether to ...）。学习者易误加 about、或把长 whether 从句误当主句谓语而读丢主干。

examples.s: The Search for Extra-terrestrial Intelligence The question of whether we are alone in the Universe has haunted humanity for centuries, but we may now stand poised on the brick of the answer to that question, as the search for radio signals from other intelligent civilizations.
While the human race debates the question of whether to reply, and perhaps carefully drafts a reply.

Quite apart from [NP/V-ing/whether 从句],.gloss: 且不说……、更何况……（撇开……不谈）
Quite apart from [NP/V-ing/whether 从句],.notes: 固定语块 quite apart from 引导排除性补充，可置于句首或句中，后接 NP、V-ing 或 whether 从句；在 apart from '除……外'之上叠加 quite 的递进语气（'更遑论'）。学习者易读慢、漏掉 quite 的递进义或误当作地点状语。

examples.s: Second, we make a very conservative assumption that we are looking for a life form that is pretty well like us, since if it differs radically from us we may well not recognize it as a life form, quite apart from whether we are able to communicate with it.

Quite apart from the impracticality of sending a reply over such large distances at short notice, it raises a host of ethical questions that would have to be addressed by the global community before any reply could be sent.

[S] may well [V] / may well not [V].gloss: 很可能……、完全有可能……（may well not：很可能不……）
[S] may well [V] / may well not [V].notes: 情态词 may 后固定加副词 well 作程度强化，整体等于高概率语气（≈ very probably），well 并非'好'义，不可拆读；否定式 may well not 也整存整取。学习者常把 well 拆开当普通副词误读。

examples.s: Second, we make a very conservative assumption that we are looking for a life form that is pretty well like us, since if it differs radically from us we may well not recognize it as a life form, quite apart from whether we are able to communicate with it.

In other words, the life form we are looking for may well have two green heads and seven fingers, but it will nevertheless resemble us in that it should communicate with its fellows, be interested in the Universe, live on a planet orbiting a star like our Sun, and perhaps most restrictively, have a chemistry, like us, based on carbon and water.

the/these [最高级] of (all) [复数N].gloss: 所有……之中最……的（最高级后名词省略，of 引出整体范围）
the/these [最高级] of (all) [复数N].notes: 新变体（相对已收录'be one of the最高级复数'）。最高级形容词后直接接 of 所有格短语、被修饰名词省略：this most basic of all the questions = the most basic question of all the questions；the driest of deserts 同理。学习者易在最高级后乱找名词、或把 of 短语误当修饰语逐词硬译。

examples.s: The simple detection of a radio signal will be sufficient to answer this most basic of all the questions.
And finally they returned yet again to the land as tortoises, some of which now live in the driest of deserts.
Halley was aware that the AU was one of the most fundamental of all astronomical measurements.

[make/find] it [adj] to [V].gloss: 使/觉得做……很困难（不可能）
[make/find] it [adj] to [V].notes: 动词后接形式宾语 it + 形容词宾补 + 后移的不定式真宾语：makes it difficult to establish timings；find it difficult to screen out ...。可与句子型 which 连用（..., which makes it difficult to ...）。学习者易把 it 误当指代前文某名词。

examples.s: Children experiencing these disorders find it difficult to screen out unimportant information, and focus on everything in the environment rather than attending to a singe activity.
When Venus begins to cross the Sun’s disc, it looks smeared not circular—which makes it difficult to establish timings.
While this showed astronomers that Venus was surrounded by thick layer of gases refracting sunlight around it, both effects made it impossible to obtain accurate timings.

The problem (with/of [NP]) is that [S V].notes: problem 作主语 + that 表语从句点明问题内容，with 短语给问题定位（The problem with novelty ... is that ...）；序数变体 the second problem is that ...。that 从句用陈述语序。学习者易把 that 从句误当定语从句读丢表语关系。

examples.s: The second problem is that Venus exhibits a halo of light when it is seen just outside the Sun’s disc.
The problem with novelty, however, is that it tends to trigger the brain’s fear system.

The/One/Best way to [V] is [by [V-ing] /.gloss: 做 X 的办法是 Y
The/One/Best way to [V] is [by [V-ing] /.notes: way 后接 to do 定语，主系表模板，表语槽位由 by + V-ing 或 to do 充当（One way to tell is by measuring ... / The best way to see things differently ... is to bombard ...）。学术说明文体高频半固定件。学习者易在 is 后错配时态或漏掉 by。

examples.s: One way to tell is by measuring the bones of their forelimbs.
The best way to see things differently to other people is to bombard the brain with things it has never encouraged before.

[V] [A] as much as [B] / not [V] as much.gloss: A 与 B 同等程度（否定式：不像 B 那么程度深）
[V] [A] as much as [B] / not [V] as much.notes: as much as 直接比较两个非数量名词性成分，谓语动词同时支配 A、B 两个宾语（involve A as much as B）；否定式 not ... as much as ... 表'不及'。学习者易把 as much as 只当不可数数量比较，读不懂接 NP 时的等同义。

examples.s: Education researchers Nelson and Soli have also suggested that recent trends in learning often involve collaborative interaction of multiple minds and tools as much as individual possession of information.
Their brains do not fail into efficiency pitfalls as much as the average person’s brain.

[S] be characterized by [NP].notes: 学术定义惯用式：be + characterized + by 引出特征（常为长并列枚举），与已收录 be known/regarded as 同族的名词化定义框架。学习者易按被动字面译'被特征化'而读不顺长枚举。

examples.s: This disorder is characterized by interlinking problems with social imagination, social communication and social interaction.

The attention deficit disorders are indicative of neurological and genetic disorders and are characterized by difficulties with sustaining attention, effort and persistence, organization skills and disinhibition.

when/while [V-ed (with/by NP)], [主句].notes: 新变体（相对已收录 when/while V-ing）：从句省略'主语 + be'，用过去分词表被动（when confronted with... / when set against...），主句主语即分词的逻辑主语。学习者易把 confronted/set 误读成过去式谓语而断错句界。

examples.s: Children experiencing an auditory function deficit can often find speech and communication very difficult to isolate and process when set against high levels of background noise.
For example, when confronted with information streaming from the eyes, the brain will interpret this information in the quickest way possible.

[N] difficulty/difficulties in/with [V-i.notes: 新变体（相对已收录 have trouble V-ing）：difficulty 作名词，后接 in/with 引出困难所在（介词后接动名词或名词），常被 exacerbate/experience 等动词支配，也可作 find ... difficult 的先行语。学习者易漏介词或在 in 后接动词原形。

examples.s: Noise in classroom can only exacerbate their difficulty in comprehending and processing verbal communication with other children and instructions from the teacher.

The attention deficit disorders are indicative of neurological and genetic disorders and are characterized by difficulties with sustaining attention, effort and persistence, organization skills and disinhibition.

the effects of [A] on [B].gloss: A 对 B 的影响
the effects of [A] on [B].notes: effect 名词化框架：of 引出原因、on 引出受影响对象；A、B 槽位常为带后置修饰的长名词短语，学习者易把 on 短语误附到 of 短语内部的名词上（effects of noise on the ability of children to learn）。of 部分可承前省略（the effects on ...）。

examples.s: The effects of noise on the ability of children to learn effectively in typical classroom environment are now the subjects of increasing concern.
In particular, the effects of noisy classrooms and activities on those experiencing disabilities in the form of auditory function deficit need thorough investigation.

[NP] [V] [that/which] [S V]（关系从句后移）.gloss: 主语名词的定语从句被谓语（多为被动或不及物动词）挤到句尾，关系代词隔动词回指主语。
[NP] [V] [that/which] [S V]（关系从句后移）.notes: 关系从句不紧跟先行词，而是越过谓语后移（extraposed relative），学习者极易把 that/which 误当宾语从句或误找先行词。属查表优势明显的骨架：先行词+谓语+that/which 从句整体模板。三例分别搭配被动 identified、不及物 took place、被动 developed。

examples.s: Tidal sites have already been identified that will produce one sixth or more of the UK’s power—and at prices competitive with modern gas turbines and undercutting those of the already ailing nuclear industry.
In April 2002 an event took place which demonstrated one of the many applications of information theory.
Products have now been developed which can convey more information than Shannon had anticipated as possible.

Born [in 时间/地点], [S] [V].gloss: 出生于某年某地的某人后来如何——传记开头的过去分词悬垂结构。
Born [in 时间/地点], [S] [V].notes: 固定虚词 Born + 时间/地点状语，逻辑主语与主句主语一致（悬垂但合习惯）。学习者常误读为被动谓语或写错逻辑主语。整存整取的传记套语。

examples.s: Born in 1916 in Petoskey, Michigan, Shannon showed an early talent for maths and for building gadgets, and made breakthroughs in the foundations of computer technology when still a student.
Born Maria Sklodowska in Poland in 1867, she is famous for her work on radioactivity, and was twice a winner of the Nobel Prize.

the first [N] to [V].gloss: 第一个做某事的某类人。
the first [N] to [V].notes: 序数词/最高级 + 名词后接 to 不定式作后置定语（= who first V-ed）。学习者易误写 *the first woman who win*，且易忽略不定式回指过去事。与清单中 one of the最高级不同：这是单数 first + to do 的预制件。

examples.s: She was the first woman to win a Noble Prize.
On May 13,1906, she was appointed to the professorship that had been left vacant on her husband’s death, becoming the first woman to teach at the Sorbonne.

As [NP] [show/observe 等动词], [主句].gloss: 正如某人/某物所表明的那样，……（as 作关系代词指代整个主句）。
As [NP] [show/observe 等动词], [主句].notes: 句首 As 引导评注性从句，as 在从句内作 show/observe/suggest 的主语或宾语，回指主句整体。学习者普遍把 as 读成『当/因为』而卡壳。固定语序：As + NP + V + 逗号 + 主句。

examples.s: As mobile phone text messages like ‘ I CN C U’ show, it is often possible to leave out a lot of data without losing much meaning.

As one writer observes: ‘Although it is now evident that artefacts are as easily altered as chronicles, public faith in their veracity endures: a tangible relic seems ipso facto real.’ Such conviction was, until recently, reflected in museum displays.

Unlike [A], [主句].gloss: 与 A 不同，……（否定式对比状语）。
Unlike [A], [主句].notes: 清单『Compared to/with [A], 主句』的新变体：Unlike 否定语义。可置句首或插入 but 之后。误读点：学习者易把 Unlike wind 当作主语，或与 dislike 混淆。三例覆盖句首与插入两种位置。

examples.s: Operating on the same principle as wind turbines, the power in sea turbines comes from tidal currents which turn blades similar to ships propellers, but, unlike wind, the tides are predictable and the power input is constant.

Unlike wind power which Britain originally developed and then abandoned for 20 years allowing the Dutch to make it a major industry, undersea turbines could become a big export earner to island nations such as Japan and New Zealand.
Unlike wind power, there are unlikely to be environmental objections.

[X] was to [V].gloss: X 当时将/后来注定会……（过去将来、命运式安排）。
[X] was to [V].notes: 清单『[X] is to [V]』的新变体：过去式 was to V 表『后来果然发生』的历史叙事将来，常配 soon/henceforth。学习者易误认为情态错误而读慢。两例分别带 soon 和 henceforth。

examples.s: Their marriage in 1895 marked the start of a partnership that was soon to achieve results of world significance.

The sudden death of her husband in 1906 was a bitter blow to Marie Curie, but was also a turning point in her career: henceforth she was to devote all her energy to completing alone the scientific work that they had undertaken.

not only [A] but (also) [B].gloss: 不仅 A，而且 B（累加式关联结构）。
not only [A] but (also) [B].notes: 与清单『not [A] but [B]先否后纠』同族但语义相反：累加而非纠正，且要求 A/B 平行对称（介词短语、不定式各成对）。误读点：平行层级易切错（I01431 中 not only 接介词短语、but 接 because of 短语，跨度极大）。

examples.s: One of Marie Curie’s outstanding achievements was to have understood the need to accumulate intense radioactive sources, not only to treat illness but also to maintain an abundant supply for research. …The existence in Pairs at the Radium Institute of a stock of 1.5 grams of radium made a decisive contribution to the success of the experiments undertaken in the years around 1930.This work prepared the way for the discovery of the neutron by Sir James Chadwick and, above all, for the discovery in 1934 by Irene and Frederic Joliot-Curie of artificial radioactivity.

Her contribution to physics had been immense, not only in her own work, the importance of which had been demonstrated by her two Nobel Prizes, but because of her influence on subsequent generations of nuclear physicists and chemists.

The [solution/trick] was/is to [V].notes: 固定模板 The + solution/trick/answer + be + to 不定式作表语。学习者易受中式思维影响写成 *The solution was V-ing* 或把 to 误读为介词。两例中 trick 句还嵌入了主谓间插入语（Shannon showed），是更完整的真实用法。

examples.s: The solution was to get a message to Voyager I to instruct it to use spares to change the failing parts.

The trick, Shannon showed, is to find ways of packaging up—‘coding’—information to cope with the ravages of noise, while staying within the information-carrying capacity—‘bandwidth’—of the communication system being used.

[V] as easily [over A] as [over B]（as…as.gloss: 在 A 上和在 B 上同样容易地……（同等程度对比，两介词短语平行）。
[V] as easily [over A] as [over B]（as…as.notes: 清单『比较级介词短语平行省略』的新变体：as + 副词 + 介词短语 + as + 介词短语。误读点：第二个 as 是关闭比较的关联词，学习者常误读为『作为/例如』而断错句；I01499 版本则是 as easily V-ed as B（被动平行）。

examples.s: Arguments can start as easily over minor points of usage as over major policies of linguistic education.

As one writer observes: ‘Although it is now evident that artefacts are as easily altered as chronicles, public faith in their veracity endures: a tangible relic seems ipso facto real.’ Such conviction was, until recently, reflected in museum displays.

as [S] [V]（非限定评注/方式从句，位置可移动）.gloss: 正如……（所知/所见/如你所知），对主句作整体评注而非原因或比较
as [S] [V]（非限定评注/方式从句，位置可移动）.notes: as 引导的非限定从句，as 指代整个主句内容或表方式，可前置、后置或插入主谓之间；学习者极易误读为 because 引导的原因从句或 as...as 比较结构（如 facts as we know them 易断错）。固定骨架：as + 人称主语 + 感知/认知动词（know/see/be aware）。

examples.s: However, exhibits must be both based on artefacts and facts as we know them, and attractively presented.
Many toxins, as I'm sure you're aware, originate from plants, or animals.
As you can see, there's a lake in the north west of the park, with a bird hide to the west of it, at the end of a path.
As you know, I've asked you here today to discuss the future of our Self-Access Centre.

what [S] [call/know as] → what are known.gloss: 所谓的……／我们称之为……的东西
what [S] [call/know as] → what are known.notes: what 引导的名词性自由关系从句，整体作介词宾语或表语，内部嵌 'call/know O as X' 的 as 补足结构；'what are known as' 中 what 表单数概念却接 are，学习者易误判主谓一致或误当疑问句。为已收录 'be known/regarded as' 的自由关系从句变体。

examples.s: Well, with some of you about to go out on field work it's timely that in this afternoon's session I'll be sharing some ideas about the reasons why groups of whales and dolphins sometimes swim ashore from the sea right onto the beach and, most often, die in what are known as 'mass strandings'.
These are both what we call simple rooms.

one thing [定语从句] be [NP/that从句].gloss: （我们注意到的/帮到我的）一件事是……
one thing [定语从句] be [NP/that从句].notes: 'one thing' 后紧跟零关系词或 that 定语从句，再用 is/was 引出表语（名词或 that 从句）；两个从句叠置，口语中无标点，学习者易把定语从句的谓语误当主句谓语。属假分裂家族（清单已有 'What S V is B'）但以 one thing 为固定锚点，整存整取。

examples.s: PAM: Well yes, the teachers agree that it is a very valuable resource but one thing we have noticed is that a lot of the students are using it to check their personal emails.
HIROKO: I think that one thing that helped me with this was the reading.

[The] [抽象N] is that [S V].gloss: （简单的）事实／（日益增长的）担忧是……
[The] [抽象N] is that [S V].notes: 抽象名词（fact/concern/worry 等）作主语 + is + that 表语从句，学术与讲座语篇中用于亮出论点；为已收录 'The [N], [V-ed], was that [S V]' 去掉分词插入的基础变体。学习者易在长主语后丢失 that 从句的归属。

examples.s: The simple fact is that not everything from history survives the historical process.
growing concern is that loud noises in the ocean cause strandings.

Can/Could I (just) ask [NP / wh-陈述语序从句]?.notes: 服务/登记类听力场景（Part 1 填表对话）中索取信息的固定套语：情态动词 + ask 直接接名词短语（ask your date of birth，ask 带单宾语表'询问'，易被误读为'要求'）或 wh-陈述语序从句。与已收录 'could you tell me wh-陈述语序' 为平行姊妹框架，不收重复但此 ask 版独立成帧。

examples.s: Could I just also ask what qualities you're looking for?
MAN: Thanks, and could I ask your date of birth?
Now can I ask some other personal details which we like to have on record?

Once [S V], [主句].gloss: 一旦……（就）……：once 引导的从属从句表示条件达成后主句即成立
Once [S V], [主句].notes: once 在此为从属连词（=as soon as / from the moment when），后接完整句子（常用完成被动 have been V-ed），逗号后接主句。与已有清单中 not until / unless / the minute 同族但未收录。误读点：学习者会把 once 按副词'一次'理解，找不到从句主语而读断。

examples.s: And once these have been allocated, little day-to-day control is exercised from the top, because this would seem like 'breaking the rules'.

However, once the initial 'debt' has been cleared - and it's been calculated that this will only take fifteen years - this underground house won't cost anything - environmentally I mean - because unlike ordinary houses, it is run in a way that is completely environmentally friendly.

It's just that [S V].gloss: 只是因为……/只是……而已：为前面提到的情况给出解释或委婉的辩解
It's just that [S V].notes: 固定开头 It's just that + 陈述句，无主句依赖，可独立成句作解释性应答。just that 不是关系词也不是指示词，而是强调连词 that 前加 just。误读点：学习者会把 just that 拆开按'仅仅是那个'直译，或找不到 it 的指代对象；实际 it 为虚指，整存整取。

examples.s: It's just that I'm having difficulty thinking how I can do that.
It's just that I don't seem to be able to discipline myself.

As [I've said/you know], [主句].gloss: 正如我说过的/如你所知，……：as 引导的评注性从句置于句首
As [I've said/you know], [主句].notes: as + 主语 + 言说/认知动词（say/know 等，常用现在完成时或一般时），后接逗号再接主句。as 表'正如'而非'因为/当……时'。误读点：学习者会把 as 读成'因为'或时间连词，导致主句逻辑读反；这是评注性插入语家族（regex 盲区提示中的评注性副词同族）。

examples.s: As I've said, it was a design for a sort of underground house, and it was built into the earth itself, with two storeys.
And, as you know, this is very damaging to the environment.
KIRA: Well, as I said before, the biggest problem for me was a lack of familiarity with the education system here.

[The/Another 评价性名词] is that [S V].gloss: （主要）问题/好处/缺点在于……：评价性名词作主语 + 表语 that 从句
[The/Another 评价性名词] is that [S V].notes: The problem / The drawback / Another characteristic / The main problem 等 + is + that 引导的表语从句（that 有时省略，如 I01965）。区别于已有清单中'the 抽象名词 that S V 同位语从句'（如 the fact that...）：此处 that 从句在系动词后作表语。误读点：学习者会把 that 当指示代词或关系代词，在 'is that' 处读断；骨架固定，整存整取优势明显。

examples.s: Another characteristic is that communication usually takes the form of conversations rather than, say, formal meetings or written memos.
TUTOR: The drawback is that everyone in the group seems to share the same ideas ... they keep being repeated in all the dissertations.
TUTOR: They'll be a good source of reference but the problem is they are sometimes too general.
The main problem is that the lecturers expect you to be critical.

One of the [复数名词] of/about [X] is that [.gloss: ……的好处/有趣之处之一在于……：one of 短语作主语引出表语 that 从句
One of the [复数名词] of/about [X] is that [.notes: one of the + 复数评价名词 + of/about + 对象名词 + is that + 从句。与已有清单'one of the 最高级'（one of the most popular attractions，纯名词短语）不同：此框架谓语固定为 is that，用于评价性论述。误读点：主语长、谓语远，学习者容易在 of 和 that 两处读断，且把 that 误判为关系词。

examples.s: Now one of the benefits of this culture is that the organisation has the ability to act quickly, so it responds well to threat, or danger on the one hand, and opportunity on the other.
Now one of the major benefits of this culture is that it's flexible.
And one of the interesting things about this project is that the owners - both professionals but not architects - wanted to be closely involved, so they decided to manage the project themselves.

[The/Another/first] thing (that) [S V] i.gloss: 我要做的另一件事是……：thing 后接关系从句，is 后直接跟动词原形
[The/Another/first] thing (that) [S V] i.notes: 已有清单'What S V is B 假分裂'的新变体：不用 wh-词而用 the/another/first + thing + 省略 that 的关系从句构成名词性割裂句，系动词后接不带 to（或带 to）的动词原形，甚至接祈使句（I01969 'is don't just take...'）。误读点：学习者预期 is 后是名词，遇到 'is talk to' / 'is don't' 会读断，且关系从句的空位需回指 thing。

examples.s: The other thing I'd like to do is talk to our technicians and see whether we could somehow limit the access to email.
Another thing I always advise is don't just take your notes and forget about them.
So the first thing they did was to look for a site.

[主句A], whereas [主句B].gloss: ……，而/然而……（前后对比）：whereas 引导的句尾对比从句
[主句A], whereas [主句B].notes: 已有清单'句尾对比 while'的新变体：用 whereas 替代 while，前后两个完整分句对比。区别于 while 让步用法。误读点：学习者不熟 whereas 的对比功能，容易把从句当成时间状语，或读不出前褒后贬/前易后难的对照关系。

examples.s: CAROLINE: Well, I found computer modelling fascinating - I have no problem following what's being taught, whereas quite a few of my classmates find it difficult.
PAUL: Maybe you found them different because you're a more mature student now, whereas when you were studying in your country you were younger and not so assertive.

[时间名词] when [S V]（when 关系从句）.gloss: ……的那个星期/时候（他们不开放/有空）：when 作关系副词修饰前面的时间名词
[时间名词] when [S V]（when 关系从句）.notes: day / week / times / the moment 等时间名词后接 when 引导的关系从句（关系副词，when 在从句中作状语而非疑问词或连词）。已有清单未收录。误读点：学习者把 when 一律当时间连词，于是寻找'主句'，结果发现前面已有主句而读乱；需识别 when 回指前面的时间名词。

examples.s: It gets very crowded on Sundays, so I suggest you visit it on a quieter day, later in the week, but not on Thursdays which is market day - you won't find anywhere to park and it's also the only day of the week when they're not open!
The lecturers must set aside certain times every week when they're available for students.

[S] would/'d be happy to [V].gloss: （我/我们/任何人）很乐意做某事——口语礼貌允诺套语
[S] would/'d be happy to [V].notes: 固定骨架：would/d 缩约式 + be + happy + to 不定式，槽位仅主语与动词短语。口语讲座/陈述结尾高频的意愿表达。误读点：I'd 缩约式常被误读为 I had，读慢或读错；学习者产出时易漏 be 说成 *I'd happy to。属自然口语语篇。注：清单已有 find+O+补语、make sure that 等，但本套语不在清单内。

examples.s: If you're interested in reading our more comprehensive findings, we've produced detailed graphic representations on the college web-site and of course any of the group would be happy to talk to you about them.
Now, I'd be happy to answer any questions you may have ...

[A] (be) on the [increase/decline], [B].gloss: 一方在增长/衰退，另一方呈相反趋势（常用于两地对冲对比）
[A] (be) on the [increase/decline], [B].notes: 骨架：on the increase / on the decline 为固定介词短语作表语或前置状语，后接另一主语相反趋势，构成城乡/两地对比对冲句。误读点1：I02146 前置的 On the decline in the countryside 不是时间状语（'在乡村衰落期间'），而是 they 的表语前置（'它们在乡村正衰落'），学习者几乎必然误读。误读点2：resurgence 与 decline 的对冲关系需整存整取才读得快。

examples.s: Garden ponds are on the increase, rural ponds are disappearing, leading to massive migration to the towns.

On the decline in the countryside, they are experiencing a resurgence in urban gardens because these days gardeners are buying lots of different plants which means there's an extensive range of seeds around, which is what they feed on.

[评注性连接副词], [主句].gloss: 句首话语标记（顺便说/与此同时/好了）+ 逗号 + 主句，标记话题转换或补充
[评注性连接副词], [主句].notes: 骨架：连接副词死守句首+逗号位，槽位为主句。三例分别为 Meanwhile（时间承接）、Incidentally（离题补充）、Now（话轮收束/回到正题）。误读点最强的是 Incidentally（=by the way，学习者普遍误读为'偶然地/coincidentally'）；Now 句首作话语重启动词而非时间义也常读慢。属清单'to be honest插入语'的句首位置新变体；中位同族成员如 I02144 的 all in all。自然口语语篇。

examples.s: Meanwhile, we were doing our own observations in selected gardens throughout the city.
Incidentally, we discovered that a massive new survey on song thrushes is about to be launched, so you should keep an eye open for that.
Now, I'd be happy to answer any questions you may have ...

[主句] - [because / this time because / wh.gloss: 完整主句说完后用破折号追加原因、评注或解释——口语补充说明框架
[主句] - [because / this time because / wh.notes: 骨架：先给完整主句，破折号后接固定功能词 because / this time because / which 谓语 或独立小句，是对'主句， which 谓语'（逗号版，已在清单）和'同位语插入'（双破折号插入，已在清单）的句尾追补新变体。听力转写中破折号对应语流的停顿-补说，阅读者常把破折号误当插入语边界而读断主句，或把追补原因当成并列谓语读错主从关系。

examples.s: What we've decided to resent today is information about just three species - because we felt these gave a good indication of the processes at work in rural and urban setting s as a whole.
And there was a clear pattern here - they proliferate where there is suitable water.

Hedgehogs are also finding it easier to live in urban areas - this time because their predators are not finding it quite so attractive to leave their rural environment, so hedgehogs have a better survival rate in cities We had lots of sightings, so all in all we had no difficulties with our efforts to count their numbers precisely.
Another factor is the provision of nesting places - which is actually better in gardens than the countryside.
